```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  rw [image_image]
  apply congr
  apply funext
  intro x
  cases x with x hx
  rw [image_eq]
  apply iff.intro
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hz
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
```
